'''Enina''', officially the '''Republic of Enina''', is an island country located in the [[Great Hinsakian Ocean]]. The Republic of Enina consists of approximately [[240 islands]] and is the western part of the [[Roline Islands]], while the eastern and central parts make up the [[Republic of Trevilla]].

It has a total area of [[List of countries and dependencies by area|548 square kilometres (212sq mi)]], making it the fourth smallest country in the world. The most populous island is [[Ravaz]], home to the country's most populous city of the same name. The capital, [[Ementav]], is located on the largest island of [[Abed Island|Abed]], in [[Abed State]]. Enina shares maritime boundaries with international waters to the south and west, the [[Republic of Trevilla]] to the east, and [[Estijan]] to the north. 

The country was originally settled approximately 600 BCE by migrants from [[Central Acrola]]. Enina was first drawn on a [[Ayuma|Ayuman]] map by the [[Lydroa|Lydroan]] missionary [[Enyea]] (1552–1617) a [[wikipedia:Missionary|missionary]], pharmacist, botanist, astronomic observer and writer. based on a description given by a group of Lycroans shipwrecked on the coast of [[Famar]]. The [[Enina islands]] were made part of the [[Lycroan Empire]] in 1621. 

During the [[Great Imperial War]], the islands were occupied by [[Easuhura]]. During the [[Red War]], skirmishes, including the major [[Battle of Eleliu]], were fought between [[Estijan]] and [[Ashain|Ashani]] troops as part of the [[Great Northern Islands campaign]]. Along with other Islands, Enina was made a part of the [[Estijan Huan Territory]] in 1697. Having [[voted in a referendum]] against joining in 1696, the islands gained full sovereignty in 1740 after the [[Collapse of the Huan]].

Politically, Enina is a [[wikipedia:Presidential_system|presidential republic]] in free association with Huan, which provides defence, funding, and access to social services. Legislative power is concentrated in the bicameral Enina National Congress. Enina's economy is based mainly on tourism, subsistence agriculture, and fishing, with a significant portion of gross national product (GNP) derived from [[wikipedia:Aid foreign|aid]]. The country uses the [[Eninan Zundetra]] as its official currency, which is pegged to the [[Estijan Zundetra]]. A smaller proportion of the population is of [[Arten descent]]. The country's official language is [[Lycroan lanuage|Lycroan]], and they have a small [[Estijan language|Estijan]] and [[Lastnu language|Lastnu]] linguistic minority.
